launcher.scope: actual supervised acceptance process exit; outer launcher return decision follows recording

native_selection.authority_policy: support Python never reads/copies/hashes/logs/archives cookie contents; native Xlib may read the exact selected authority
native_selection.runtime_comparison: r3 stripped DISPLAY; this lane preserves only the current explicitly selected local desktop
native_selection.transport: explicit Xlib unix transport; no TCP fallback
native_selection.trust_limit: source-controlled Python; native Tcl_Init and Tk/Xlib internals trusted; no hostile introspection or syscall isolation

packaging.excludes: final report/summary/completion bind the verified archive after packaging

cache_absence.policy: source-only importer; ENOENT without cache-byte access

result.error_message: runtime effect denied, including a caught exception

usage: satgs-operator [-h] [--workspace PATH] [--format {human,json}]
                      {init,status,reload,catalog,report,location-preview,components-preview,apply,cancel,plan,export,replay}
                      ...

Inspect and prepare a private station workspace without starting operational
owners.

positional arguments:
  {init,status,reload,catalog,report,location-preview,components-preview,apply,cancel,plan,export,replay}
    init                Create a new synthetic scratch workspace.
    status              Inspect saved selection and available evidence.
    reload              Read the current saved selection again.
    catalog             Inspect canonical profiles and component contracts.
    report              Inspect the current operation report.
    location-preview    Preview explicit manual coordinates.
    components-preview  Preview canonical or Custom selection.
    apply               Confirm and save the identified preview.
    cancel              Cancel a preview without changing station
                        configuration.
    plan                Compute local numerical pass opportunities.
    export              Export a redacted report to a new private file.
    replay              Select an explicitly synthetic status scenario.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --workspace PATH
  --format {human,json}
